Subject: Initial ask: MAP + lead times for Dedicated/Private capacity

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — TiltAI is excited about Redwood's routing and caching story. We're starting to scope procurement and I need concrete lead-time commitments and recommended pool sizing to build into our internal MAP. High level:

- Production model family: Llama-3 70B (fp16 / q8-ready)
- Expected launch window: late Q2 (targeting 2026-06-22)
- Estimated steady-state concurrent sessions: 120 qps typical; 300 qps peak
- Latency target: 200-300ms p95 for 1k token responses
- Data residency: US region; some customers in EU later

Two asks for you:
1) Can you summarize realistic Dedicated lead times (order -> capacity live) and Private (VPC/on-prem) onboarding timelines?
2) Based on the numbers above, what committed GPU tranche would you recommend for a 12-month contract vs. a 6-month ramp?

I've attached a short requirements doc with our traffic profile. Procurement is looped in for timing expectations.

Appreciate any initial ranges — we'll convert into MAP milestones and internal approvals.

Best,
Sasha
Sasha Moore
Head of Product, TiltAI
Attachments: TiltAI_requirements.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Moore <sasha@tiltai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial ask: MAP + lead times for Dedicated/Private capacity

Hi Sasha — thanks for the clear profile and the requirements doc. Short answer up front: Dedicated pools typically require 8–12 weeks from signed commitment to steady-state throughput (includes procurement of reserved GPU capacity and integration testing). Private (VPC) onboarding averages 10–14 weeks (networking, KMS, audit prep), and on-prem can extend to 14–20 weeks depending on site readiness.

Sizing guidance based on your numbers and an assumption of Llama-3 70B at ~16k tokens/minute/gpu (approx):
- 6-month ramp (conservative): start with a committed tranche equivalent to 24 A100-80GB equivalent GPUs, with a 2-stage burst pool + 30% autoscale buffer.
- 12-month commitment (recommended for cost predictability): 40 A100-80GB-equivalent GPUs committed in tranches (20 day-1, +10 at month 4, +10 at month 8).

Notes / rationale:
- Continuous batching and prefix caching will materially reduce token burn in steady-state — we folded a 20–30% effective reduction into these numbers.
- If you prioritize hard latency SLOs across multi-tenant flows, plan to pin model variants (quantized) to dedicated nodes to avoid cold-cache penalties.

Next steps I propose for the MAP:
- We draft a mutual action plan with milestones: signature, SOC2 evidence transfer, staging access, 30-day perf validation, DAG rollback windows, production flip.
- Ben (cc'd) will pull pricing tranches and early-credit options.
- Can procurement share a target signing date? If you aim for 2026-03-15 we can align a tranche delivery schedule.

I'm attaching a draft MAP v2 that lays this timeline out and an estimated GPU burn csv.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: TiltAI_MAP_v2.pdf (application/pdf), estimated-gpu-burn.csv (text/csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Marissa / Logan — forwarding Sasha's ask and Mina's initial sizing. Quick internal notes:

- TiltAI is a strong fit for a 12-month reserved commitment if we can meet their latency SLOs.
- Pricing: recommend a two-tranche discount schedule (month 0–6: standard reserved rate, month 7–12: +8% discount), plus a one-time onboarding credit (10% of month-1 invoice) if they sign by 2026-03-15.
- Risk: if they push for VPC private deployment, margin compresses ~12% due to additional engineering and audit effort. We should capture that in the MAP as a contingency line item.

Action items:
- Marissa: prepare an offer letter with the above economics and an explicit clause for private/VPC cost delta.
- Logan: validate SLA exceptions for an ambitious 200–300ms p95 on 1k tokens (we may need an elevated SLO and an escape hatch).

-Ben

- Private/VPC delta: +12% on base reserved rate to cover engineering and compliance work.

- SOC2 artifact transfer 5 business days after signature.

Next steps (please confirm by reply):

- Procurement: confirm acceptance of the private/VPC delta and DocuSign routing.
- We will share the DocuSign package and an initial onboarding project plan on 2026-02-15.
